verses.original: Ὅλως ἀκούεται πορνεία ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ πορνεία τοιαύτη ἥτις οὐδὲ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ὥστε τινα ἔχειν τοῦ πατρὸς γυναῖκά
verses.transliteration: Holōs akouetai porneia en hymin kai porneia toiautē hētis oude en tois ethnesin hōste tina echein tou patros gynaika
verses.literal: {It is} actually reported [that there is] sexual immorality among you and [of a kind] that is . . . intolerable even among - pagans - A man has [his] father’s wife

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐστέ πεφυσιωμένοι καὶ οὐχὶ μᾶλλον ἐπενθήσατε ἵνα ἀρθῇ ἐκ ὑμῶν μέσου ὁ πράξας τοῦτο τὸ ἔργον
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis este pephysiōmenoi kai ouchi mallon epenthēsate hina arthē ek hymōn mesou ho praxas touto to ergon
verses.literal: And you are proud - Shouldn’t you rather have been stricken with grief [and] have removed from your [fellowship] the [man who] did this . . . . . .

verses.original: μὲν γάρ Ἐγὼ ἀπὼν τῷ σώματι δὲ παρὼν τῷ πνεύματι ἤδη κέκρικα τὸν οὕτως κατεργασάμενον τοῦτο ὡς παρὼν
verses.transliteration: men gar Egō apōn tō sōmati de parōn tō pneumati ēdē kekrika ton houtōs katergasamenon touto hōs parōn
verses.literal: vvv Although I am absent [ from you ] - in body - I am present [with you ] - in spirit vvv and I have already pronounced judgment on the [one] [who] did this just as if I were present

verses.original: ὑμῶν συναχθέντων ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ ἡμῶν Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐμοῦ τοῦ πνεύματος σὺν τῇ δυνάμει ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: hymōn synachthentōn en tō onomati tou hēmōn Kyriou Iēsou kai emou tou pneumatos syn tē dynamei hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: [When] you are assembled in the name of our Lord Jesus and I [am with you] - in spirit along with the power - of the Lord Jesus

verses.original: παραδοῦναι τὸν τοιοῦτον τῷ Σατανᾷ εἰς ὄλεθρον τῆς σαρκός ἵνα τὸ πνεῦμα σωθῇ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: paradounai ton toiouton tō Satana eis olethron tēs sarkos hina to pneuma sōthē en tē hēmera tou Kyriou
verses.literal: hand - this man {over} - to Satan for [the] destruction of the flesh so that [his] spirit may be saved on the Day of the Lord

verses.original: ὑμῶν τὸ καύχημα Οὐ καλὸν οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι μικρὰ ζύμη ζυμοῖ τὸ ὅλον φύραμα
verses.transliteration: hymōn to kauchēma Ou kalon ouk oidate hoti mikra zymē zymoi to holon phyrama
verses.literal: Your - boasting [is] not good vvv Do you not know that a little leaven works through the whole batch [of dough]

verses.original: ἐκκαθάρατε τὴν παλαιὰν ζύμην ἵνα ἦτε νέον ἄζυμοι φύραμα καθώς ἐστε γὰρ Χριστός ἡμῶν τὸ πάσχα καὶ ἐτύθη
verses.transliteration: ekkatharate tēn palaian zymēn hina ēte neon azymoi phyrama kathōs este gar Christos hēmōn to pascha kai etythē
verses.literal: Get rid of the old leaven that you may be a new unleavened batch as you really are For Christ our - Passover lamb - has been sacrificed

verses.original: ὥστε ἑορτάζωμεν μὴ ἐν παλαιᾷ ζύμῃ μηδὲ ἐν ζύμῃ κακίας καὶ πονηρίας ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀζύμοις εἰλικρινείας καὶ ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: hōste heortazōmen mē en palaia zymē mēde en zymē kakias kai ponērias all’ en azymois eilikrineias kai alētheias
verses.literal: Therefore let us keep the feast not with [the] old bread, leavened . . . . . . . . . with malice and wickedness but with [the] unleavened [bread] of sincerity and of truth

verses.original: Ἔγραψα ὑμῖν ἐν τῇ ἐπιστολῇ μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι πόρνοις
verses.transliteration: Egrapsa hymin en tē epistolē mē synanamignysthai pornois
verses.literal: I wrote you in [my] letter not to associate with sexually immoral [people]

verses.original: οὐ πάντως τοῖς πόρνοις τούτου τοῦ κόσμου ἢ τοῖς πλεονέκταις καὶ ἅρπαξιν ἢ εἰδωλολάτραις ἐπεὶ ἄρα ὠφείλετε ἐξελθεῖν ἐκ τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: ou pantōs tois pornois toutou tou kosmou ē tois pleonektais kai harpaxin ē eidōlolatrais epei ara ōpheilete exelthein ek tou kosmou
verses.literal: I was not [including ] the sexually immoral of this - world or the greedy and swindlers or idolaters - In that case you would have to leave . . . [this] world

verses.original: δὲ νῦν ἔγραψα ὑμῖν μὴ συναναμίγνυσθαι τις ὀνομαζόμενος ἀδελφὸς ἐάν ᾖ πόρνος ἢ πλεονέκτης ἢ εἰδωλολάτρης ἢ λοίδορος ἢ μέθυσος ἢ ἅρπαξ τῷ τοιούτῳ μηδὲ συνεσθίειν
verses.transliteration: de nyn egrapsa hymin mē synanamignysthai tis onomazomenos adelphos ean ē pornos ē pleonektēs ē eidōlolatrēs ē loidoros ē methysos ē harpax tō toioutō mēde synesthiein
verses.literal: But now I am writing you not to associate with anyone who claims to be a brother [but] is sexually immoral or greedy - an idolater or a verbal abuser - a drunkard or a swindler With such a man {do} not even eat

verses.original: γάρ Τί μοι κρίνειν τοὺς ἔξω ὑμεῖς οὐχὶ κρίνετε τοὺς ἔσω
verses.transliteration: gar Ti moi krinein tous exō hymeis ouchi krinete tous esō
verses.literal: - What business of mine [is it] to judge those outside [the church ] {Are} you not to judge those inside

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Θεὸς κρίνει τοὺς ἔξω Ἐξάρατε τὸν πονηρὸν ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: de ho Theos krinei tous exō Exarate ton ponēron ex hymōn autōn
verses.literal: - - God will judge those outside Expel the wicked [man] from among you . . .
